notes: A multistate outbreak report with case counts, a cantaloupe exposure contrast (77% vs 29%) tested at p<0.001 by an unnamed test, and a 14-day shorter time to source identification. The article has no tables and the figure is described only, so no figure values are used. view_issues: Cases are described as genetically related 'within seven allele differences' and then defined as 'within 10 allele differences'; the 7 threshold appears to be the detection rule, not the case definition.
